Both units on that order were delivered July 1, so the order itself is closed out.

On the RMA: I can't see the queue status from here, so I've pinged the team and one of them will jump into this chat. Stay with me here, and if you step away you'll get the answer by email.

Processing normally runs up to 10 days after the unit lands at the warehouse. One thing they'll ask: was the unit ever overclocked or modified? That's not covered.
No, I even had to turn it down below where I received it because the PSU kept overheating in an air conditioned basement away from windows.

Good, that's underclocking, not overclocking. It doesn't affect your coverage at all, and running it below stock to keep a PSU cool is a reasonable thing to do.

Worth knowing: a bad PSU can often be replaced on its own, no need to send the whole miner back. I've added that to what the team is looking at.
